records.name: Montserrat
records.summary_text:
Same-sex activity is legal in Montserrat: its prohibitions were swept away in January 2001 by the same Order in Council that overrode the region's reluctant legislatures. What public LGBT life existed was effectively extinguished twice by disaster: the 1989 hurricane and the 1995 volcanic eruptions that buried the southern half of the island and depopulated it, leaving a scatter of survivors in the north and a gay presence described as 'decimated', only partially recovered.

sources.title: LGBTQ rights in Montserrat
sources.claim_summary: Lesbian, gay, bisexual, and transgender (LGBT) persons in  Montserrat face legal challenges not experienced by non-LGBTQ residents. Same-sex sexual activity has been legal in Montserrat since 2001.

records.name: Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha
records.summary_text: A scattered South Atlantic territory of three island groups that legislated equality island by island: the 2009 constitutional order imposed by the administering state bans discrimination on grounds including sexual orientation across all three, and equal age of consent sits at 16. Marriage equality arrived in staggered fashion — the first dependency's council approved the ordinance 5-0 in May 2016 and it commenced January 2017, the most remote island followed in August 2017, and the principal island itself completed the set on 20 December 2017 — with adoption law following the same year.</

records.name: Guernsey
records.summary_text:
A self-governing Crown Dependency with its own parliament, Guernsey moved briskly through the 2010s: in 2011 it aligned blood-donation rules with the metropole, ending the HIV-era ban on gay and bisexual donors; in June 2015 the states rewrote the adoption law to open adoption to same-sex couples, removing a fifty-year bar on unmarried couples; and in December 2015 the states approved same-sex marriage 37-7, rejecting civil-partnership and secular-union alternatives as insufficient, with the law itself commencing from spring 2018.
